scope: Safety-only evaluator repair after confirmation A v1 aborted before any private evaluation or selector scoring.

verified_failure_mechanism.diagnosis: A small number of timed-out candidate programs printed hundreds of megabytes before termination. The old evaluator retained the full stdout in each JSON result and had no capture-size limit.
verified_failure_mechanism.evidence: confirmation_a30_v1_abort_record.json and byte-offset sampling of the preserved v1 evaluation JSONL

evaluator_change.stdin_delivery: background thread so the wall-clock deadline starts even if the candidate ignores a large stdin pipe
evaluator_change.process_policy: terminate the candidate process tree when the time or output limit is exceeded
unchanged: all frozen public and private test cases

cap_safety_audit.interpretation: The 1 MiB capture cap is more than 2000 times the largest expected answer in either confirmation split; it is an execution-safety boundary, not an answer-length tuning parameter.

verification.targeted_tests: 14 passed in 1.67s before the final fast-finite-output edge case was added

analysis_policy.v1_partial_pool: invalid and preserved only as failure evidence
analysis_policy.v2: must start from all 30 frozen A problems and exactly 300 planned requests
analysis_policy.confirmation_b_status: unopened until A v2 completes and passes integrity checks

retry_budget: Exactly one safety-repaired A v2 generation run. A repeated evaluator failure stops the confirmation branch for a new direction review.
